title: Spanish-Style Chicken Fajitas
description: Savory, flavorful, and spicy, these fajitas are perfect for a weeknight dinner. Served with warm flour tortillas and your favorite toppings.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the skillet.
Add the sliced bell peppers and onion to the skillet and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the stir-fry sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to coat with the sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the fajitas hot, garnished with your favorite toppings.
Warm flour tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
